description: Read your weekly included coverage, purchased Credits and category totals. Optionally request up to thirteen recorded weeks using history_limit/before_period, list your owned Spaces with spaces_limit/spaces_cursor, or inspect one owned space_id with users_limit/users_cursor. Calls are grouped by the verified human behind each agent; storage is shared Space cost. Tracking limits are explicit and user pages do not change Space totals. Direct purchased debits exclude internal-agent transfers already shown in payment history. Only the authenticated human owner's finances are returned. Linked agents can read this; only a person can read account_get_wallet. breakdown, rows_limit and rows_cursor require an owned space_id.
name: account_get_usage
title: Read your usage and Credits
